description: Attach citations, retrieval date, originating query/brief, and confidence to every finding; decay confidence score with age and display age visibly; enforce status = active / disputed / superseded with blended search returning active + disputed (disputed surfaces with a "sources conflict" warning and both sources) and excluding superseded by default, with superseded retrievable only via `--include-archived`.

requirements.description: Every finding carries: citations (URL + title + retrieval date), originating query, originating brief ID, confidence score, and status. Confidence decays over time using a configurable age-decay function (e.g., exponential decay with configurable half-life). Displayed findings show human-readable age. Status enforcement: active findings are returned by default; disputed findings are returned with a visible 'sources conflict' warning and both conflicting sources; superseded findings are excluded from default results and retrievable only with --include-archived. Blended search (learnings + live) applies these filters consistently.
requirements.title: Trust and Freshness Metadata — Citations, Confidence Decay, Status Visibility

validation.notes: Age-decay function returns a lower confidence value for a finding created 90 days ago vs. 1 day ago, given the same initial confidence
Age-decay function never returns a negative confidence value
Default findings query excludes rows with status=superseded
Default findings query includes rows with status=active and status=disputed
Disputed finding in query results includes both conflicting source references and a conflict_warning flag=true
Findings query with --include-archived flag includes rows with status=superseded
Displayed age field is human-readable (e.g., '3 days ago', '2 months ago') and correct relative to current timestamp
Blended federated query returning both learnings and live-web hits applies status filter: superseded findings absent, disputed findings present with warning
A finding created 180 days ago has a lower effective confidence than its stored confidence due to age decay, and this decayed value is returned in the query result
Users are never silently misled by outdated or conflicting findings — superseded findings are invisible by default and disputed findings carry explicit warnings
The decay in confidence over time naturally surfaces the need to refresh older research findings

title: Trust and Freshness Metadata
